requirements: R1: Implement actual HTTP 401 fix for employee dossier search, document listing, and report generation endpoints, replacing the @WithMockUser stub.
R2: Implement automatic access restriction to closed strains and analytical reports based on Moodle departments and courses.
R3: Enforce that all product code requirements are fulfilled directly rather than stubbed, satisfying the refusal criteria finding.

slices.title: Resolve falsification findings for API and authentication
slices.jtbd: When implementing the falsification fixes for this epic, I want to repair the real authentication layer and apply access controls, so that the product functions securely without stubs.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a request to search dossiers or list documents without valid credentials, When the API is invoked, Then an actual HTTP 401 is returned.
Given an authenticated user, When they request closed strains or reports, Then access is restricted to their Moodle departments and courses.
Given a test for report generation, When executed, Then it verifies against the real authentication mechanism without @WithMockUser stubs.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of finding 1, 2, and 3 are resolved via direct code patches
